name: Disneyland Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe Morning Egg, Bacon & Cheddar Croissant
brandOrRestaurant: Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Fluffy eggs, aged cheddar, and bacon inside a soft flaky butter croissant—or a plain warm Butter Croissant—makes an effortless rope-drop breakfast.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Mobile-order early for a morning pickup window on Main Street and pair with water or decaf/low-acid tea.
watchOuts: Flaky croissant pastry contains butter—take a lactase enzyme if sensitive to butterfat
